content_sections.heading: NTA Office Assistant Recruitment 2026 Notification
content_sections.text: The recruitment aims to strengthen administrative and office support services at NTA. Selected candidates will assist with record maintenance, clerical activities, official correspondence, data entry, file management and coordination of examination-related activities. Download NTA Office Assistant Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: NTA Office Assistant Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: NTA has announced 15 Office Assistant positions on a contractual basis. The selected candidates will ordinarily be posted at the agency's headquarters in New Delhi. The National Testing Agency reserves the right to fill all or any of the advertised positions depending on its organizational requirements.

content_sections.heading: NTA Office Assistant Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for NTA Office Assistant posts must possess a recognized graduate degree, working knowledge of computer applications and good communication skills in English and Hindi. Relevant administrative or clerical work experience is desirable rather than an explicitly mandatory requirement. Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university or institution. Working knowledge of computers, including MS Word, MS Excel, PowerPoint, email and internet-based applications. Good written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi. NTA has identified the following experience and professional skills as desirable for Office Assistant positions: Experience in office administration or clerical work. Experience in data entry, file management or secretarial assistance. Familiarity with e-Office systems and digital record management. Knowledge of routine administrative and office procedures. Ability to organize work and meet deadlines. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders. However, NTA reserves the right to determine its shortlisting parameters and selection criteria. Meeting the minimum eligibility requirements does not guarantee shortlisting or selection.

content_sections.heading: NTA Office Assistant Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants for NTA Office Assistant positions must be below 50 years of age. Age relaxation may be considered for exceptional candidates in accordance with NTA norms.

rows.details: May be considered for exceptional candidates as per NTA norms

content_sections.heading: NTA Office Assistant Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The indicative remuneration for NTA Office Assistants is equivalent to Pay Level 4 of the 7th Central Pay Commission. The final remuneration and other contractual conditions will be approved by the competent authority and communicated to selected candidates. Since the engagement is contractual, candidates should not assume that regular government employee allowances, benefits or service conditions will automatically apply. The final compensation package will be governed by the approved contractual terms.

content_sections.heading: NTA Office Assistant Contract Duration and Employment Conditions
content_sections.text: The Office Assistant engagement will initially be for five years from the date of joining. The contract may be extended based on the candidate's performance and the organizational requirements of NTA. The contractual engagement does not confer any right or claim for regular appointment, continued employment or permanent absorption in the National Testing Agency.

content_sections.heading: NTA Office Assistant Job Profile and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Office Assistants will provide administrative and clerical support to facilitate the smooth functioning of NTA offices and assigned sections. The role involves maintaining records, handling official correspondence and assisting with routine administrative activities. Selected candidates may also be assigned additional office-related duties by the reporting officer or competent authority.

rows.key_duties: Assist with routine administrative and clerical activities
Maintain physical and electronic files, registers, records and documents
Scan, dispatch and track correspondence and assist with preparing letters and minutes
Assist in drafting, formatting, printing, photocopying and compiling reports
Prepare and update spreadsheets, databases and office records
Facilitate movement of documents between sections and maintain movement records
Coordinate meetings, appointments, official visits and meeting materials
Assist with logistical arrangements for examinations, workshops and other NTA activities
Handle telephone calls, emails and visitors and route queries to concerned officials
Ensure safe custody and confidentiality of official records and information

content_sections.heading: NTA Office Assistant Job Location
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will ordinarily be posted at the National Testing Agency headquarters in New Delhi. However, they may be assigned duties at other locations or participate in examination-related activities according to organizational requirements. Candidates interested in similar administrative, clerical and graduate-level employment opportunities can also check the latest government job notifications .

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under NTA Office Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The National Testing Agency has announced 15 Office Assistant vacancies on a contractual basis at its headquarters in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NTA Office Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications within two weeks of the advertisement. The official notification does not explicitly mention a calendar closing date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification for NTA Office Assistant posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university or institution, working knowledge of computers and good written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi.

faq.question: Q4. Can fresh graduates apply for NTA Office Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fresh graduates who satisfy the prescribed eligibility requirements may apply. Relevant office administration or clerical experience is desirable, and the advertisement does not specify mandatory minimum work experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an NTA Office Assistant?
faq.answer: The indicative remuneration for NTA Office Assistants is equivalent to Pay Level 4 of the 7th Central Pay Commission. The final contractual remuneration will be approved by the competent authority.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for NTA Office Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be below 50 years of age. Age relaxation may be considered for exceptional candidates according to NTA norms.

faq.question: Q7. Is NTA Office Assistant recruitment a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No. The Office Assistant engagement is purely contractual for an initial period of five years. It does not confer any automatic right to regular appointment or permanent absorption in NTA.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NTA Office Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process may include application scrutiny and personal interaction or an interview. NTA will determine the final selection criteria, shortlisting parameters and number of candidates called at each stage.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application fee for NTA Office Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official recruitment advertisement does not specify an application fee or payment procedure.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for NTA Office Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must complete the prescribed Annexure-I application form and send it along with a detailed CV or resume and required supporting documents to [email protected] within the prescribed period.
